digest.component_or_area: LLM workflow model class resolution and escalation ladder
propositions: Pass-1 ladder entries are bare Anthropic model IDs that resolve to provider anthropic regardless of configured provider, causing split-brain routing when a non-Anthropic provider is configured.
Escalation via models_at_or_above returns bare Anthropic IDs even when the primary model is Bedrock-qualified, causing silent provider mismatch on context-limit recovery.

MODEL_LADDER serves dual roles (escalation order and context window sizing via substring match) such that replacing bare names with class names breaks largest_window_tokens for all qualified model IDs.
Three separate batch-runner and workflow sites independently copy model_ladder[0] to cfg.model without resolution, requiring class-name wiring at each consumer rather than a single funnel.

Reserved class-name values (trivial, standard, frontier) must resolve through load_class_slots at runtime via resolve_model_string, which f844 already delivered and tested, rather than at YAML load time or through schema changes.
